blocks.text: The fifth straw poll was opened up as an approval voting poll to all members of the State Committee in adiditon to county leaders (County Affiliate officers and Acting County Chairs/County Liaisons). This was an approval voting poll, and 28 out of 125 people voted. The results were: Sharpe (12), Purtell (10), Whitmer (8), Kennedy (7), and NOTA (4). 4 indicated they do not plan on petitioning this year and there were several write-in votes. Chase Oliver received 2 and Mike ter Maat received 1 vote. Note that if either Oliver or ter Maat is chosen as the LPNY’s stand-in candidate, they would be disqualified from running for the nomination at the National Convention. blocks.text: A Petitioning Committee was established on August 31, 2023 by the Executive Committee, for the purpose of exploring ideas and options for the statewide petitioning drive. One major idea was to recruit down ballot candidates, especially those in districts that cross counties, because their petitions would allow the Presidential and Vice-Presidnetial stand-in candidates on the ballot. If you are interested in being a down ballot candidate to help with this effort, please contact us.

blocks.text: However, disappointed by the divisive rhetoric within the Republican Party, particularly attributed to Donald Trump, Michael switched his party. He disassociated himself from the GOP and aligned with the Libertarian Party of New York, after years of labeling himself as a Libertarian Republican. Recognizing the absence of a Libertarian presence in Delaware County, Michael volunteered to establish the party’s affiliate there, aiming to offer voters an alternative to the traditional ways of Republican versus Democrat. At the Libertarian Party of New York’s State Committee meeting, he was nominated and approved as Acting Chair and County Liaison for Delaware County.

blocks.text: Beyond politics, Michael is deeply involved in community service. He volunteers at the Friends Of Recovery of Delaware and Otsego Counties, a local addiction recovery center, and works as a Direct Support Professional, and advocating for mental health awareness as a certified Peer Specialist. His diverse interests also extend to music, as he learns to play the guitar, and spiritual pursuits, serving as an ordained Minister from Universal Life Church Ministries. In his leisure time, he enjoys walks through downtown Delhi, appreciating the charm of his local community.
